compiled_state.title: As a maintainer, I have a structural test suite and replay tests verifying cross-file consistency and the translation case catch
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement the structural test suite (validates static presence AND semantic alignment across all changed files) and the replay test suite (translation case, no-input feature, 7-sub-case decision tree calibration) using the harness from S7.

**Why**: This is the verification umbrella — proves the epic's coordinated changes are present, semantically aligned, and behaviorally effective via end-to-end replay against the motivating cases.

**Scope**:
- IN: Structural test asserting all 8 markers (Inputs row in Tell-Me-More table; non-optional Inputs bullet in Understanding Summary; gap-analysis inference-signal scan with 5-second timeout in epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md Part B; structural-marker convention; inverted 4-step decision tree in scenario-red-team.md with co-located scope parentheticals; schema enum update; bold rendering rule co-located with approval-gate step; Premise to confirm fallback in post-scrutiny-handlers.md); semantic alignment tests (schema enum value matches sub-bullet 1 category name; trigger word list documented consistently); replay test for translation case (asserts sourcing decision surfaces via at least one of three layers); replay tests for 7-sub-case decision tree calibration matrix; replay test for no-input feature confirming "no external inputs" via Read/Grep against produced ticket.
- OUT: Test harness infrastructure (covered by S7); LLM-behavioral test variance handling beyond what S7 provides.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a structural test in tests/brainstorm/ asserts all 8 markers from S1-S6 are present in their expected files with semantic alignment (schema enum matches category name; trigger word list consistent), verified by running the test and asserting exit code 0.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-file structural consistency"
- When this story is complete, a replay test runs `/dso:brainstorm "translate from English to Spanish"` and asserts the Spanish-content sourcing decision surfaces before approval (via gap-analysis scan re-entry, OR bolded structural marker, OR assumption-category Step 1 fire), verified by running the test against the harness from S7.
  ← Satisfies: "Translation replay"
- When this story is complete, replay tests for the 7 sub-cases of the decision tree calibration matrix (epic SC3 a-g) all pass — fire/suppress verdicts match design intent.
  ← Satisfies: "Decision-tree calibration replay"
- When this story is complete, a no-input feature replay (refactor / hook-fix / infra-only brainstorm) confirms the Inputs bullet states "no external inputs" verified by Read/Grep against the produced epic ticket description.
  ← Satisfies: "No-input feature replay"

## Considerations

- [Testing] TDD ordering inversion: this story currently lands all verification AFTER implementation stories S1-S6, inverting the project's TDD invariant (CLAUDE.md Never Do These #16). Brainstorm prompt-level changes are LLM-behavioral and replay tests are inherently post-hoc; structural tests CAN be RED-first by writing assertions that fail until their corresponding markers land. During implementation, prefer landing the structural test as RED first before each impl story (S1-S6) makes it pass; replay tests follow as GREEN-only after the dependency chain completes. Document this ordering choice in the test files.
- [Testing] Replay tests are LLM-probabilistic; use canonical-marker assertions (sourcing question surfaces in dialogue text) rather than full-output equality; allow multi-run aggregation if needed.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
